answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded escrow, so splitting stake cannot dilute accountability: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated-pair evidence triggers penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²). Detection also applies asymmetric depreciation across linked escrows, compounding forfeitures into an exponential capital loss. A sable swarm on a terrace of validators may appear diverse, but its hollow multiplication of names only increases its exposure.
